gold_insights.insight: Tier 1 fines cover controller, processor, DPO, DPIA, certification, and monitoring obligations.
Tier 2 fines cover processing principles, user rights, third-country transfers, and authority orders.
Checklist requires documented legal bases, minimized collection, and consent records.
It specifies 30-day access, erasure, portability, objections, SCCs, and 72-hour breach notification.
